# Arduboy compatibility layer

This directory contains an early C compatibility layer and three source-level
programs that are compiled natively for STM32F407. It does not execute AVR
`.hex` or `.arduboy` packages.

The imported files did not include upstream URLs, version tags, copyright
notices, or license texts. Their provenance must be established before a
firmware image containing them is redistributed. The STM32 port code is kept
outside this directory under `APP/Arduboy`.
